create_formatter_instance: create a Formatter instance with custom format patterns and a default format spec
format_metrics_with_call: call the Formatter on a metrics dict to get formatted string values for each metric
filter_metrics_with_include_keys: use include_keys to whitelist only specific metric names when formatting a metrics dict
filter_metrics_with_exclude_keys: use exclude_keys to blacklist unwanted metric names when formatting a metrics dict
get_relevant_metrics: call get_relevant_metrics to filter a metrics dict by include and exclude key patterns
